title: A clearer iPhone Browse
eyebrow: Wisconsin Creative · Local Simulator review · October 17, 2026
lede: Native controls, clearer hierarchy, and safer recovery across the latest iPhone screens. Schedule remains the single event destination.

changes.was: Browse repeated the Schedule event list.
changes.now: Events is removed from Browse; legacy Events navigation opens Schedule.

changes.was: Old reads and failed reloads could lose draft or refresh state.
changes.now: Request ownership, save snapshots, and partial-save receipts protect current state.

changes.was: Downloads could drift to a newer file version and preview size relied on metadata.
changes.now: Downloads pin the displayed version, check actual bytes, limit SVG previews, and clean up per-owner and session files.

verification: Xcode 27.1: warning-free Simulator build on iPhone 18 Pro Max, iOS 27.0.
222 native tests pass, including fractional grace periods, report generations, file byte limits, and temporary-file lifetime.
715 iOS source-contract tests, TypeScript, changed-test lint, project generation, iOS drift, and audit-gap checks pass.
Manual fixture interaction: size menu selection, local add, review menu selection from L to XL, independent Color menu, and offline Review access.
Earlier signed build installed and launched on iPhone 16 Pro; account refresh and widget snapshot read-back succeeded.
Final physical install deferred when the phone disconnected, per the user's choice to finish with Simulator.
notes: The retained source patches and capture manifests document which build produced each comparison. Hash-bound receipts prove image integrity and matching declared inputs, not an independent build attestation.
No production mutation, authenticated save/reload race exercise, share-extension completion, APNs delivery, camera, or passkey proof is claimed.
Earlier device console contained system input, PointerUI, shared preferences, and PDF diagnostics. No app crash or failed startup request was observed; those diagnostics are not represented as fixed.
The browser policy blocked file-URL rendering of this report. The source PNGs were inspected individually, and receipt and HTML generation validation passed; the Codex file-panel open was queued.
